chunks: They said, "We will not give up [worshiping it] until Moses returns to us."

key_terms.نَّبْرَحَ: We will not cease or give up

ai.seo_question: What did the Israelites say about the golden calf while waiting for Moses?
ai.summary: In the Shia exegetical tradition, this declaration by the Banu Isra'il underscores not merely impatience but a deep-seated spiritual regression, where they preferred the tangible, immediate presence of Aaron over the divine promise of Moses' return. Their vow to remain 'steadfast' (عَاكِفِينَ) in worship of the calf illustrates the human tendency to cling to familiar idols when divine guidance seems delayed, a theme often linked to the concept of *ghaybah* (occultation) in later Shia thought. This moment marks a critical juncture where the Israelites' faith wavered under the pressure of waiting, highlighting the psychological struggle between certainty and doubt.
